stories.title: Over 100 dead in eight months: Spain faces backlash over high-speed rail safety
stories.summary: Spain's high-speed rail network faces scrutiny after two crashes in eight months killed over 100 people, including 69 near Toledo and 46 in Adamuz. Preliminary findings indicate a signaling malfunction and manual control errors, while experts cite low maintenance spending and the absence of the European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) as contributing factors.

stories.title: Why Does Spain Keep Having Deadly Rail Accidents?
stories.summary: A signaling failure on the Madrid-Seville high-speed line caused a Renfe train to collide with a stationary Iryo train, killing at least 69 people. Transport Minister Óscar Puente blamed the operator's decision to allow the Renfe train to resume travel at normal speed despite the obstruction.

stories.title: LG Builds the Brains, Samsung the Hands in Humanoid Robot Race With China
stories.summary: LG Electronics plans to bring a 10,000-square-meter “Data Factory” in Seoul into full operation in the fourth quarter to accumulate 500,000 hours of robot training data this year. The company targets unveiling a bipedal humanoid robot based on Nvidia’s Isaac GR00T model in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Why Spain Is Re-examining Its High-speed Rail Network After The Toledo Disaster
stories.summary: Transport Minister Óscar Puente labeled the movement order that allowed a train from Madrid to plow into the rear of a stationary service an "inexplicable decision." Ongoing transport ministry investigations examine whether the crash resulted from human error, flawed manual fallback procedures, or broader oversight failures.

stories.title: New Robot Usability Questionnaire Passes Key Validation Test With AI and Non-AI Robots
stories.summary: Researchers at the German Federal Institute for Occupational Safety and Health validated the Usability Questionnaire for Robotic Systems with 64 participants using Spot and MiR 250 robots. The study confirmed the instrument's convergent validity, showing it works consistently whether users believe they are operating an AI-based system or a conventional one.

stories.title: UN takes its automated driving rulebook on tour through Beijing
stories.summary: UN officials used a Beijing conference to press for harmonized automated driving rules, with UNECE deputy executive secretary Dmitry Mariyasin noting China's central role in drafting the framework. The event highlighted regulatory progress in Canada and Russia, while noting that no timetable for binding national alignment emerged.

stories.title: From the Spanish railway tragedy: How does the 4,000km network operate?
Amazon’s delivery drones are built to fly through rain, extreme heat and freezing temperatures
stories.summary: Amazon Air drones deliver packages weighing 5 pounds or less within two hours, operating in rain, extreme heat, and below-freezing temperatures. The service is currently available in 14 cities across nine states, with plans to expand to nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of the year.

stories.title: Spain reckons with second deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
stories.summary: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year killed 69 people when one train struck another from behind near Urda. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez pledged an investigation and safety improvements ahead of the Nov. 29 national election.

stories.title: US tests self-powered counter-drone system, can be set up quickly without relying on local power
stories.summary: Soldiers in the United States are testing Trust Automation’s Rapidly Deployable Small-Unmanned Air Defense System, or RD-SUADS, a palletized counter-drone system designed to detect, track, identify and defeat small drones. The self-powered unit fits on a standard 463L military cargo pallet and incorporates an integrated diesel generator providing up to four days of independent operation between refueling.

stories.title: California high-speed rail chief quits amid billowing expenses scandal
stories.summary: California high-speed rail chief Ian Choudri resigned Wednesday, citing personal priorities, after a state inspector general report found the agency paid $543,000 in disallowed travel reimbursements. Joe Stephenshaw, director of California’s department of finance, will serve as interim CEO.

stories.title: FAA Amends Class D Airspace and Establishes Class E Airspace at Chandler and Phoenix, AZ, Raising Chandler Class D Ceiling to Below 4,000 Feet MSL
stories.summary: The FAA issued a final rule amending Class D airspace and establishing Class E airspace at Chandler and Phoenix, AZ, raising the Chandler Class D ceiling to below 4,000 feet MSL. The action follows biennial airspace reviews under FAA Order JO 7400.2R and updates coordinates for Mesa Gateway Airport.

stories.title: Rail service partly suspended after Spain's deadly train collision
stories.summary: Rail services between Madrid and Andalusia were suspended on Thursday after a Renfe-operated AVE train struck a stationary Iryo train near Urda station in the province of Toledo on Wednesday. Spain's independent transport accident investigation authority AITAT reported the death toll reached 69, while Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez pledged a thorough investigation into the collision.

stories.title: Coratia raises ₹18 crore in bridge round to scale underwater robotics
stories.summary: Coratia Technologies secured ₹18 crore in a bridge funding round led by MGF Kavachh to support a ₹66 crore Indian Navy contract under the iDEX initiative. The investment will accelerate research and development, manufacturing, and deployment of indigenous underwater robotics, including its Jalasimha UWROV, which has achieved Technology Readiness Level 9.

stories.title: Rolling Business Aviation Daily Briefs (October 2026)
stories.summary: Wing and Walmart are expanding drone delivery service to Denver and Seattle in 2027, adding to existing operations in Dallas-Fort Worth, Atlanta, Houston, and Orlando. The expansion supports plans to serve more than 270 Walmart locations across the U.S. by the end of 2027.

stories.title: DJI Teases a Folding Thermal Drone for November 5 With the 5TD Gimbal
stories.summary: DJI Enterprise will launch a new product on November 5, 2026, at 7 AM EST, featuring a folding airframe and a gimbal matching the Matrice 5TD’s window layout. The teaser highlights a 1280 by 1024 thermal sensor, a capability the FCC’s Docket 26-189 proposal defines as “military-grade” and proposes barring from import and sale.

stories.title: Advising lenders on financing Italo’s German investment and refinancing in Italy
FCC clears drone operations in 800MHz band
stories.summary: The FCC voted to remove a restriction preventing drones from operating in 50 megahertz of spectrum in the 800 MHz band. The Commission stated that modern wireless networks employ advanced technologies to prevent interference, making the decades-old airborne use restriction unnecessary for unmanned aircraft systems.

stories.title: China Tightens Export Controls on Drone Engines, Autopilots and Communication Systems
stories.summary: China will require export licenses for drone components, including autopilots and engines, starting 18 November. The Ministry of Commerce issued the measures on 19 October, covering items like brushless motors rated at 48 V or more and drones capable of beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Chief Executive Resigns After State Investigators Question Spending
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, chief executive for California’s High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned on Wednesday after state investigators questioned spending. Joe Stephenshaw, who previously led the state Department of Finance, will replace Choudri. State investigators found consultants flew first class and traveled to a nightclub on taxpayers’ dime, sometimes at Choudri’s request. The board voted earlier this month to limit Choudri’s contracting authority, requiring in-house legal counsel to sign off first on contracts under $25 million.

stories.title: Midwest Unmanned Aircraft System test site launches in Indiana
stories.summary: Indiana launched the Midwest Unmanned Air Systems Test Site at Terre Haute Regional Airport on Thursday, creating a regional resource for companies, defense organizations, public-safety agencies, and researchers developing next-generation drones and autonomous aviation technologies.

stories.title: YYForce Deploys 11 Commercial Hospitality Robots at Novotel & Mercure Singapore on Stevens
stories.summary: YYForce Inc. deployed an 11-robot autonomous service fleet at the Novotel Singapore on Stevens and Mercure Singapore on Stevens complex under a 24-month commercial agreement. The robots handle intra-hotel logistics, guest room deliveries, and inter-floor service workflows.

stories.title: FCDO updates Spain rail warning after Toledo crash
stories.summary: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office updated its Spain travel advice on 28 October 2026 following a deadly high-speed rail collision near Toledo. The advisory warns of significant disruption to rail services in central and southern Spain and directs passengers to Renfe for assistance.

stories.title: Final stage in mega Sydney rail project opens for commuters
stories.summary: The final stage of Sydney’s Metro rail project opened to commuters on Friday, with the inaugural 4.31am service departing Bankstown station. The line, which cost just under $23 billion, features ten new stations and offers services every four minutes during peak times, reducing travel to the Sydney CBD to 28 minutes.

stories.title: Lt. Gov. Driscoll, State Officials Break Ground on Pittsfield Rail Improvements
stories.summary: State officials broke ground on rail infrastructure improvements in Pittsfield, Mass., to support the permanent Berkshire Flyer and future West-East Rail connections. The project includes a fourth track turnout and siding rehabilitation at the Pittsfield yard, funded by an $18 million MassDOT investment.

stories.title: EDA to launch drone technology hubs in Latvia and Netherlands with 2027 exercises
stories.summary: The European Defence Agency will organize 2027 operational exercises to develop Drone Technology Hubs in Selonia, Latvia, and Scheveningen, the Netherlands. These pilot hubs, part of the EU’s Priority Capability Area on Drone and Counter-Drone Systems, will focus on aerial, ground, and maritime drone technologies to accelerate innovation for armed forces.

stories.title: Spain mourns 69 killed in train crash as safety failures investigated
stories.summary: Spain declared three days of national mourning after a train collision near Urda killed at least 69 people. Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that rail controllers allowed a Renfe train to resume travelling despite another service remaining stationary on the same track, a decision he described as inexplicable.

stories.title: Philly considers new tax on Uber Eats robots and Waymo driverless taxis
stories.summary: Councilmember Jim Harrity introduced a proposal Thursday to tax companies operating delivery robots and driverless vehicles in Philadelphia. The bill calls for a 5% tax on gross cost or $0.50 for delivery services, and 5% or $1 for transportation services, with revenue directed to the Zero Fare Program.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics Raises $100 Million Series A Led By Marlinspike Partners
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics raised $100 million in a Series A led by Marlinspike Partners to build a 130,000-square-foot factory in Emeryville, California. The company plans to use the funds to expand its autonomous manufacturing platform and increase its manufacturing footprint approximately twentyfold.

stories.title: ITA Airways Teams Up with Archer Aviation to Bring eVTOL Taxis to Italy
stories.summary: ITA Airways and Archer Aviation announced an agreement on 29 May to evaluate electric vertical take-off and landing air taxi services across major Italian cities using the Archer Midnight eVTOL. The deal marks ITA as the first European airline in Archer's partner network, though no routes, launch dates, or aircraft orders have been specified.

stories.title: Blaine receives $66 million to build overpass at Bell Road rail crossing
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration awarded Blaine $66.4 million to build an overpass at the Bell Road rail crossing, replacing the existing at-grade intersection. The city has begun preliminary design and is taking public feedback, with no timeline yet for construction to begin.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone defenses debunk the myth of inevitable Russian victory
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces shot down over four hundred thousand Russian drones since the beginning of 2026 using expanding fleets of FPV drones and specialized interceptors. This drone-based air defense capability has enabled Ukraine to restrict Russia’s offensive capabilities and launch successful small-scale counteroffensives that liberated strategically important territory.

stories.title: White House makes Section 232 determination regarding foreign-made robots
Trump Holds Off on New Machinery, Robotics Tariffs in Win for Manufacturers
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced it will impose no new tariffs on robotics, industrial machinery, and their parts and components. The Department of Commerce and USTR must jointly pursue negotiations to address national security threats, with updates due to the president within 180 days.

stories.title: Autonomous A2Z Develops Skateboard-Style Self-Driving Cargo Vehicle
stories.summary: Autonomous A2Z developed a skateboard-style self-driving cargo vehicle capable of carrying up to 1.3 tons of freight. The company completed the platform under a government-funded project supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, with partners including KC Motors and Chungbuk National University. The vehicle retains Level 4 self-driving sensors from the ROii model while adding a flat upper deck for industrial parts. In 2027, Autonomous A2Z will demonstrate freight transport between parts suppliers and the Gwangju Global Motors assembly plant to refine a commercial model.

stories.title: Audio recordings reveal decisions made moments before deadly train crash in Spain
stories.summary: The Madrid control center authorized a Renfe high-speed train to resume its journey at normal speed without limitations, despite a stationary Iryo train ahead, causing a collision that killed at least 69 people. Transportation minister Óscar Puente stated the decision broke protocol after a computer malfunction stopped multiple trains at 8:30 a.m.

stories.title: 2026 Robotics Handbook looks at humanoids, AI, and design choices
USA Tested RD-SUADS Anti-Drone Electronic Warfare System in Germany
stories.summary: U.S. service members from the Army, Air Force, and Marine Corps tested the RD-SUADS electronic warfare system at the Grafenwöhr training area in Germany. The Trust Automation-developed system features a 170 × 274 × 229 cm container, four radar panels, and a diesel generator supporting four days of continuous operation.

stories.title: Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control Keeps a Simulated Autonomous
stories.summary: Ali Mahmood and Róbert Szabolcsi published a simulation study in Discover Vehicles demonstrating that a safety-constrained nonlinear model predictive control approach keeps a virtual vehicle inside road boundaries during lane changes under disturbances. The controller maintained peak lateral tracking errors below 0.25 meters across four test phases, including simultaneous velocity and steering noise, while satisfying hard constraints on lateral acceleration and road boundaries at every simulation step.

stories.title: Safety questions mount as Spain’s high-speed rail disaster death toll rises to 69
stories.summary: The death toll from Spain’s high-speed rail disaster rose to 69 on Thursday after a collision near Urda in Toledo province. Transport Minister Oscar Puente stated that a technical failure of the LZB automatic train protection system stopped at least six trains before controllers authorized a Renfe train to resume normal speed, a decision he called “inexplicable.”

stories.title: Ukraine is getting ground robots to carry out one of the riskiest battlefield tasks — and they're doing an excellent job
Matternet Partners with Swisslog Healthcare to Bring M3 Drone Delivery to North American Hospitals
stories.summary: Matternet partnered with TransLogic, a Swisslog Healthcare company, to expand drone delivery across North American hospitals using the M3 platform. The companies plan to begin working with hospital systems in California, Florida, and Arizona during the first year of the partnership.

stories.title: Pentagon Becomes eVTOL Industry's Largest Customer, Giving Archer and Joby Early Revenue
stories.summary: The Pentagon became the largest customer of the electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) industry, delivering early and reliable revenue to developers Archer Aviation and Joby Aviation. This military demand offsets the long wait for commercial air taxi certification and launch, strengthening the investment case for both companies.

stories.title: Why The US Navy Is Awarding Boeing Up To $80 Million To Improve A Drone That Isn't Even Operational Yet
stories.summary: The US Navy's Naval Air Systems Command finalized an $80 million contract with Boeing to improve the MQ-25A Stingray, the first carrier-capable unmanned aerial vehicle. The indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity agreement secures engineering and system-improvement work through October 2031, focusing on maturing the Unmanned Carrier Aviation Mission Control System and developing specialized Ground Control Stations.

stories.title: Germany and Ukraine test armed ground robot for frontline deployment
stories.summary: German and Ukrainian defence companies tested the GEREON armed ground robot, with the first systems fitted with the SABER weapons module due for delivery by the end of 2026. The cooperation agreement was signed in early October during German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's state visit to Kyiv.

stories.title: New Jersey Bill Could Bar Tesla's Camera-Only Robotaxis From State Pilot
stories.summary: New Jersey Senate Bill 1677 would require fully autonomous vehicles to include a camera system plus two distinct sensing modalities, a threshold Tesla’s camera-only robotaxis would likely fail. The bill mandates 50,000 miles of supervised in-state testing without a major incident before companies can remove human safety drivers.

stories.title: Europe's trains are actually getting safer, despite recent tragedies in Spain
stories.summary: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that a computer system failure stopped six trains on just over 60km of track between Madrid and Seville, while another was manually given clearance to move.

stories.title: UC engineers drones that know if they're damaged
stories.summary: University of Cincinnati doctoral student Prissha Chawla and her research partners converted drone motor and propeller sounds into data that ground station computers use to alert operators that a drone is not airworthy before takeoff. The project, which began in 2024 with NASA interest, aims to prevent crashes by detecting chipped, cracked, or failing components.

stories.title: Waymo Ojai Privacy: 5 Risks Riders Should Know [2026]
stories.summary: Missy Cummings of George Mason University called for an independent investigation of Waymo's Zeekr-built Ojai vans after AZ Family reported privacy concerns on October 28-29, 2026. Waymo states the vehicles arrive without connected-car technology and that it shares no rider identity data with the automaker, while a bipartisan bill to ban China-built vehicles cleared the Senate Commerce Committee in July.

stories.title: Greek container ship goes down off Bulgaria after naval drone strike
stories.summary: The Bulgarian Government said a Greek container ship sank after being hit by naval drones off Bulgaria on Wednesday. The Liberian-flagged Contship Jet, loaded with 421 containers, was badly damaged by three sea drones as it passed through Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone.

stories.title: Elbit to unveil underwater drones as it expands autonomous naval portfolio
stories.summary: Elbit Systems will present its unmanned underwater vehicle capabilities for the first time at Euronaval 2026, expanding its autonomous naval portfolio after acquiring International Submarine Engineering. The company plans to showcase the technology alongside its Seagull family of unmanned surface vessels, though Israeli exhibitors face restrictions at the French event.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Authority names new interim CEO after former chief's abrupt resignation
stories.summary: The High-Speed Rail Board appointed Department of Finance head Joe Stephenshaw as interim CEO after Ian Choudri resigned Wednesday night. Stephenshaw begins his role on Nov. 3, replacing Choudri, who was stripped of contracting power following an audit revealing nearly $593,000 in unallowable expenses.

stories.title: The head of California high-speed rail has stepped down. What's next for the troubled project?
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, CEO of the California High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned late Wednesday following an Office of the Inspector General investigation that found consultants billed the authority nearly $600,000 for unauthorized expenses. The board appointed Joe Stephenshaw, former director of the state Department of Finance, as interim successor, with plans to authorize the purchase of the first three train sets and adopt final environmental clearance for the Los Angeles to Anaheim segment.

stories.title: Fresno carrier DTL to run 75 Kodiak driverless trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI signed a binding agreement Wednesday to put its autonomous driving system in 75 trucks owned by DTL Transport, a Fresno, California, carrier. DTL will pay a per-mile fee to use the Kodiak Driver on lanes between Dallas and El Paso, Texas, and Interstate 20 between Dallas and Atlanta.

stories.title: AUVSI Gives the FCC as Many Speakers as the FAA at Its DC Drone Forum
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) announced the program for its Drone & AAM Policy Symposium, November 9 and 10 at Nationals Park in Washington. Its published speaker list names four Federal Communications Commission officials and four from the FAA, which also gets an executive session of its own.

stories.title: Greek cargo ship sinks after drone strike off Bulgaria
stories.summary: A Greek container ship sank off Bulgaria's coast after being struck by naval drones Wednesday, the Bulgarian government said. The Liberian-flagged CONTSHIP JET, loaded with 421 containers, was badly damaged by three sea drones as it passed through Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).

stories.title: Can inertial navigation make ground-robot swarms real?
Philly is once again looking at a $1-per-ride tax. But this time, it’s on the robots.
Russian Forces Strike Dnipro Train Station With Jet-Powered Drone, Killing 14
Inside AGCO’s Humanoid Robot Pilot with Agility Robotics
stories.summary: AGCO signed a commercial agreement with Agility Robotics to pilot its Digit humanoid robot at its Hesston, Kansas, production facility starting in 2027. The robot will initially sort and stack parts and place totes for storage, tasks chosen to improve ergonomic safety by absorbing repetitive, physically demanding work.

stories.title: Rantizo Prototype Pairs GPS With LORAN, Which the US Shut Off in 2010
stories.summary: Rantizo unveiled a prototype fixed-wing surveillance drone on October 28, listing GPS and LORAN for navigation despite the US Coast Guard shutting down its LORAN-C network in 2010. The company expects the aircraft on sale in mid-2027, with a targeted range of up to 130 miles and a top speed of 75 mph.

stories.title: Ship that was hit by drones off Bulgaria sinks; Filipinos, other crew safe in Varna
stories.summary: The Bulgarian government said a Greek container ship hit by naval drones off Bulgaria on Wednesday has sunk. The Liberian-flagged CONTSHIP JET, loaded with 421 containers, was damaged by three sea drones while passing through Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone.

stories.title: Europe can benefit from driverless tech developed in US: Volvo Group
stories.summary: Ingor Stürmer, head of Volvo Autonomous Solutions, said lessons from self-driving truck tests in North America could help bring commercial applications to Europe in the near future. He noted that the biggest challenge for Europe is the multi-nation make up of the region with a myriad of different transport regulations.

stories.title: FCC Opens 800 MHz Spectrum to Drones as Part 108 Deadline Nears
stories.summary: The FCC voted 3-0 to end a 1991 airborne ban and open 50 MHz of 800 MHz cellular spectrum to drones. The decision does not authorize beyond-visual-line-of-sight operations, which depend on the FAA's Part 108 rule due December 7.

stories.title: Self-driving car services could be in the works for Calgary
stories.summary: Waymo expressed interest in operating in Calgary, prompting the City of Calgary to look forward to discussions. Alberta’s current legislation does not specifically allow or prohibit highly automated vehicles, but the province is working with Transport Canada to consider a potential framework for autonomous vehicles.

stories.title: AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure productive robot work at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
stories.summary: AGIBOT introduced Worken, a proposed framework for measuring the productive work performed by robots in real-world environments, at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai. The company also unveiled its AHA3 integrated hardware platform, GO-3 Preview, WITA-Omni 1.0, G2 Max, and Link-U OS 1.0.

stories.title: Elbit Systems to present underwater drones at Euronaval 2026 in Paris
stories.summary: Elbit Systems announced Thursday that it will present its Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) capabilities for the first time at Euronaval 2026 in Paris, November 3-6. The company added these systems to its portfolio following last week's acquisition of International Submarine Engineering Ltd. (ISE), which has delivered more than 250 underwater vehicles to customers in over 20 countries.

stories.title: Austin Stabbing at The Buzz Mill Ends With Suspect Crashing Into Robotaxi
stories.summary: A suspect fled a stabbing at The Buzz Mill in Austin Wednesday night and crashed into a robotaxi before police caught up with them. Officers responded to the coffee shop at 1505 Town Creek Drive at approximately 8:54 p.m., and both victims were taken to local hospitals.

stories.title: Russia Drone Strike Kills At Least 14 At Dnipro Train Station
Pentagon denies Iran captured a US drone
stories.summary: The US military rejected Iran's claim that it captured an MQM-170 Outlaw drone near the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command spokesman Tim Hawkins called the report false, stating the Revolutionary Guard has repeatedly lied.

stories.title: U.S. rail traffic up 7.8% as intermodal leads gainers
stories.summary: U.S. rail traffic increased 7.8% in the week ended Oct. 24, with intermodal shipments rising 11.3% and carloads up 3.6%, according to Association of American Railroads data.

stories.title: CSIR-CSIO Develops Sound Based Anti-Drone Tech to Neutralise Drones by Disrupting their Internal Stabilisation Hardware
stories.summary: Scientists at the Chandigarh-based Central Scientific Instruments Organisation (CSIR-CSIO) introduced an acoustic anti-drone system that neutralizes drones by disrupting their internal MEMS gyroscopes with high-intensity sound waves. The organization has issued an expression of interest to identify industry partners for mass manufacturing, aiming to provide a cost-effective, ammunition-free tool for securing military bases and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: European Commission rejects Baltic states' request for additional funding for anti-drone defenses
stories.summary: The European Commission rejected Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia's request for 500 million euros to develop anti-drone defenses, according to LRT. European Commissioner for Defense and Space Andrius Kubilius suggested using funds from the EU's 150 billion euro SAFE financial instrument instead.

stories.title: ITA Airways partners with Archer Aviation to develop Italian air taxi network
ANRA Advances NATO-Tested Counter-Drone Technology With Airspace Data for Enhanced Threat Detection
stories.summary: ANRA Technologies advanced its counter-drone software and systems to TRL 7 after participating in NATO interoperability exercises and U.S. Army DIRT Days. The company's SIOP and TACO systems integrate sensor data with airspace information to help operators distinguish authorized drone activity from potential threats.

stories.title: Ex-Tesla Autopilot head calls vision-only a ‘weird religious stance’
stories.summary: GM Chief Product Officer Sterling Anderson, who led Tesla's Autopilot program in 2015 and 2016, criticized Tesla's vision-only self-driving approach as a "weird religious stance that ignores physics." Anderson stated that removing radar makes no sense because cameras cannot see through dense fog or measure instantaneous velocity like radar can.

stories.title: Control centre communication in focus as Spain faces rail safety reckoning
stories.summary: Early investigations into the fatal collision between two high speed trains at Urda near Toledo on October 28 focus on a serious failure of communications. Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated the incident has left at least 68 people dead.

stories.title: Unifly wins Dominican Republic airport drone-management project under national rollout
stories.summary: Terra Drone said on October 29, 2026, that its Belgian subsidiary Unifly had been selected as a technology partner for a drone traffic-management project at two major airports in the Dominican Republic, marking the group's first involvement in developing a nationwide system in Latin America. The initial deployment covers Las Americas International Airport and Punta Cana International Airport, with Unifly's initial contract worth €630,000 covering deployment and licensing.

stories.title: FCC Moves Toward New Drone Spectrum and Counter-Drone Radar Rules
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission will consider new rules at its November 19 open meeting to expand radio spectrum for unmanned aircraft systems, support counter-drone radar detection, and update satellite connectivity provisions.

stories.title: NHTSA Workshop on Aftermarket Modifications and ADAS Performance
stories.source: Transportation Department, National Highway Traffic Safety Administration

stories.title: Signature Aviation and UrbanV Launch Ground Support Network for Advanced Air Mobility
stories.summary: Signature Aviation and UrbanV formally launched the Signature UrbanV Alliance on Oct. 21 to develop ground support infrastructure for advanced air mobility across the United States. The venture will initially use existing Signature Aviation terminals for electric aircraft operations before expanding into dedicated vertiports.

stories.title: AUVSI Drone & AAM Policy Symposium 2026: Lawmakers, Regulators and Industry Convene in Washington as Drone and AAM Rules Take Shape
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) will host the Drone & AAM Policy Symposium on November 9 and 10 at Nationals Park in Arlington, VA. The two-day forum convenes lawmakers, regulators, and industry leaders to discuss the implementation of the FAA Reauthorization Act, new Executive Orders, and BVLOS flight rules.

stories.title: Urda: the downfall of Spain’s high-speed rail network
stories.summary: Renfe's AVE 2080 rear-ended Iryo train 6076 at Urda station on 28 October, leaving at least 68 dead. Adif's control centre authorised the AVE to resume normal running after a computer failure, whereas regulations required sight-restricted running.

stories.title: $130M FRA grant will upgrade Springfield, Massachusetts, train station
Matternet Gains Access to More Than 2,300 North American Hospitals Through Swisslog Healthcare Partnership
stories.summary: Matternet announced a partnership with TransLogic, a Swisslog Healthcare company, under which TransLogic’s sales team will offer Matternet’s drone delivery systems to its existing hospital customers. The agreement gives Matternet access to an established healthcare sales channel, with initial focus on hospitals in California, Florida, and Arizona during its first year.

stories.title: Kodiak announces historic order for driverless trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI Inc. announced a binding agreement with DTL Transport Inc. to deploy its autonomous driving system in 75 driverless trucks. DTL will pay a per-mile fee to operate the vehicles on Interstate 10 between Dallas and El Paso, Texas, and Interstate 20 between Dallas and Atlanta.

stories.title: Peoria OKs taking passenger rail effort to next step, but some see project as a 'boondoggle'
stories.summary: The Peoria City Council approved $42,000 in additional funding to begin Step 2 of the Federal Railroad Administration’s corridor identification program for passenger rail service to Chicago. The city will cover approximately $67,000 of the $1.7 million initial cost, with the full Step 2 budget estimated at $4.6 million.

stories.title: U.S. Commercial Cleaning Robots Market to Reach US$ 3.38 Billion by 2033, Driven by Autonomous Cleaning Technology and Facility Automation
stories.summary: DataM Intelligence estimates the U.S. commercial cleaning robots market will reach US$ 3,376.63 million by 2033, growing from US$ 788.64 million in 2026. In October 2026, the Federal Communications Commission granted a conditional exemption for Matic Robots’ Model 4MA0001 floor cleaner and Model 4DK0008 charging dock.

stories.title: FCC Opens 50 MHz of Cellular Spectrum for Drone Operations
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted on October 29 to remove a 1991 restriction, opening 50 megahertz of the 800 MHz Cellular band for drone command, control, and payload operations. The agency determined modern wireless technologies prevent interference, though the decision does not change FAA flight authorization requirements.

stories.title: San Diego Leads U.S. in Drone Contracts, But Rivals Are Closing In Fast
stories.summary: The San Diego Regional Economic Development Corporation unveiled a Defense Innovation Roadmap on October 27 to help local contractors capture more of the Pentagon's expanding spending on emerging weapons technology. The region receives an average of $1.5 billion a year in autonomous and unmanned systems contracts, more than any other region in the country, but local defense leaders warned that other cities are now organizing aggressively to take a bigger slice of the drone-dollar pie.

stories.title: Bittium and Unikie demonstrate autonomous drone communications at NATO event
stories.summary: Bittium and Unikie demonstrated the integration of autonomous drones with a tactical communications network at the NATO Innovation Range Capability Demonstrator in Oulu, Finland, on October 28–29. The demonstration combined Bittium’s Tough SDR Unmanned radio module with Unikie’s autonomous drone capabilities to showcase how the network works together with drone technology in a practical test environment.

stories.title: FCC Opens 800 MHz to Drones, but BVLOS Still Waits on FAA Part 108
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission voted 3-0 on October 29 to allow drones to use the 800 MHz Cellular band, ending a 1991 airborne ban. Routine beyond visual line of sight flight still depends on the FAA’s Part 108 rule, which federal law requires by December 7.

stories.title: ESA Funds Ondas-Backed Drone Maker to Fly 10 Minutes Without GPS
stories.summary: The European Space Agency signed a contract with Rift Dynamics to develop navigation for low-cost drones that can operate for 10 minutes without GPS during jamming or spoofing. The system will undergo trials in the Arctic, with Comrod serving as the subcontractor.

stories.title: Spain’s high-speed rail network faces scrutiny after deadly collision
stories.summary: Leaked audio recordings indicate Adif controllers instructed a driver to disconnect the LZB safety system and resume travel at 200 km/h minutes before a collision in central Spain killed at least 68 people. Transport Minister Oscar Puente cited system failure and human error as possible factors in the crash, which occurred on the 1992 Madrid-Seville route.

stories.title: Wing Says Good Neighbors Fly Quiet. A Texas Yard Saw 52 Amazon Drones
What Latin America Can Teach the United States about Drone Defense
Finland and Varjo test virtual counter-drone training for soldiers
stories.summary: The Finnish Defence Forces and Varjo announced on Oct. 29 that they are testing mixed reality training to prepare soldiers to spot and counter small attack drones. The pilot uses Varjo’s XR-4 Series headsets to simulate first-person-view drones and loitering munitions in a real training environment.

stories.title: UGA partners with UW-Madison on $15M rural autonomous vehicle project
Zipline Announces Quieter Drone Deliveries as Communities Raise Noise Concerns
stories.summary: Zipline deployed new sound-optimized dynamic flying technology across its fleet, reducing overall sound exposure per flight by 68% and peak sound levels by 24% compared with its 2025 fleet. The company reports that flights now take an average of 53 seconds less, with aircraft spending approximately 50% more time in fixed-wing flight and a 21% reduction in energy use per flight.

stories.title: Protecting critical infrastructure from drones
stories.summary: Huaxia Wang, an assistant professor at Rowan University, is developing a drone detection system that uses antennas to capture radio frequency signals between drones and operators. Wang is partnering with Ziang Gao of AeroDefense to commercialize the technology, with the team collecting data across stadiums, urban areas, and campuses to train the model under diverse conditions.

stories.title: CEO of California's doomed $231B bullet train project suddenly quits
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, chief executive officer of the California High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned on Wednesday. The authority expects the project to cost between $126 billion and $231 billion and run out of money in 2027 without laying a single piece of track.

stories.title: FCC Proposes New Rules for Drone Communications and Counter-Drone Radar
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) will consider new rules to expand radio spectrum access for drone communications and counter-drone radar at its November 19 open meeting. The proposals include modernizing the 450 MHz aviation service for data links and allowing ground-based radar in the 24.45–24.65 GHz band to detect drones near airports and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: First Shift: Robotics tariffs, maritime risk and port congestion reshape supply chain decisions
stories.summary: The administration found imported robotics and industrial machinery pose national-security risks but withheld immediate tariffs, giving U.S. manufacturers temporary relief while agencies negotiate with trading partners over the next 180 days.

stories.title: Naval drones sink Israeli-operated cargo ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
stories.summary: Unidentified naval drones struck the Israeli-operated cargo ship Contship Jet off Varna, Bulgaria, on Wednesday, sinking the vessel and 421 containers. The Bulgarian Navy reported three unmanned surface vehicles hit the ship, which had departed Haifa for Constanta, Romania. All crew members were rescued unharmed, and the incident marks the ninth civilian ship struck in the Black Sea this month.

stories.title: RSIPF drone unit returns from Palau and Tuvalu deployments
US military denies claim that Iran captured American drone
stories.summary: The United States military denied Iran’s claim that it seized control of an American surveillance drone near the Strait of Hormuz. US Central Command spokesman Tim Hawkins called the report false, while Iranian state television said the Revolutionary Guard landed the MQM-170 Outlaw drone in Iranian territory.

stories.title: ITA Airways to evaluate air taxi services with the Archer Midnight eVTOL
stories.summary: ITA Airways signed a conditional agreement with Archer to evaluate electric air taxi services in Italy using the Midnight eVTOL. The airline aims to integrate the four-passenger aircraft into its network, with Archer estimating a sub-10-minute flight between Rome Fiumicino Airport and the city center.

stories.title: Amazon North Haven Drone Decision Not Until 2027, Official Says
stories.summary: North Haven First Selectman Michael Freda said no decision on Amazon’s plan to fly up to 1,000 Prime Air drone deliveries a day will be made until 2027, following a Monday, October 26, meeting of regional leaders. Connecticut’s Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP) has received more than 1,000 public comments and aims to issue a final ruling by mid-November.

stories.title: U.S. military trains on palletized SUADS anti-drone system
IG Defence, Oman’s MSA Global explore production of drone systems
stories.summary: India’s IG Defence and Oman-based MSA Global signed a memorandum of understanding to explore the co-development and local manufacture of drone and counter-drone systems for Oman and the wider Gulf Cooperation Council. The exploratory agreement covers three systems: KAL, a one-way attack unmanned aerial system with a stated range of up to 1,000 kilometres; BAJ, an unmanned aerial interceptor for counter-unmanned aircraft system use; and JWALA, a micro-missile system under development for counter-drone applications.

stories.title: Swarmer Targets Ground Drone Expansion With Ratel Robotics Acquisition
stories.summary: Swarmer outlined its proposed acquisition of Ratel Robotics for $7.2 million in cash and 1,064,942 shares, with potential earn-outs adding up to $7.2 million and 4,422,125 shares. The deal, expected to close in the fourth quarter, combines Swarmer's aerial drone software with Ratel's ground vehicles to support mobile drone launches and logistics missions.

stories.title: US Navy wants more visible role for drone boats as one deploys for the first time
stories.summary: Adm. James Kilby, the vice chief of naval operations, testified that the U.S. Navy deployed a medium unmanned surface vessel with the USS Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group in the Pacific, marking the platform's first operational deployment. The Navy expects to receive its first formal delivery of 30 such vessels by the end of fiscal 2027.

stories.title: Archer Aviation plans air taxis for Houston, Austin and DFW
stories.summary: Archer Aviation plans to begin zero-emission electric air taxi flights in Houston, Austin, and Dallas-Fort Worth next year. The company will use its Midnight eVTOL aircraft to connect major airports and business districts, aiming to reduce 60- to 90-minute drives to 10- to 20-minute flights.

stories.title: Rail corridor projects need bankable plans to unlock investment
stories.summary: Mihlali Gqada, Freight Logistics Specialist at the Department of Transport, said 31 projects from a 2012 regional infrastructure plan lack investment models, limiting progress. She stated that cross-border rail movement requires countries to coordinate planning, financing, and investment through a multilateral railway route management group.

stories.title: Briefly: DTL to add Kodiak driverless technology to 75 trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI, Inc. announced an agreement with DTL Transport Inc. to deploy the Kodiak Driver in 75 driverless trucks owned and operated by DTL. This marks the first publicly announced definitive agreement by an interstate trucking company to operate driverless trucks within their own fleet under a Driver-As-A-Service model, with DTL paying a per-mile fee.

stories.title: AgiBot Introduces Worken Metric to Measure Productive Robot Labor
stories.summary: AgiBot introduced the Worken metric at AgiBot Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai to measure productive robot labor by multiplying active robots, autonomous working hours, and an output-efficiency ratio. The company also launched the G2 Max industrial robot, which features 21 degrees of freedom and a dual-arm handling capacity of up to 40 kilograms.

stories.title: Bulgarian Navy Rescues 18 Seafarers After Drone Attack On Cargo Ship In Black Sea
stories.summary: The Bulgarian Navy rescued all 18 crew members of the Liberian-flagged container ship Contship Jet after three naval drones attacked the vessel 21 nautical miles from Shabla on October 28, 2026. The crew, comprising 14 Philippine nationals and four Ukrainians, was transported to Varna for medical attention, while Bulgarian, Turkish, and Romanian defence ministers condemned the incident and requested additional NATO and EU technical assistance for maritime surveillance.

stories.title: Ship sinks off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast after being hit by drones
stories.summary: A ship sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast after being hit by drones.

stories.title: Is my C-UAS radar cyber secure? EU-funded FACT research develops remote cyber-security validation
stories.summary: The Federated Advanced Cyber-Physical Test Range (FACT) project demonstrated remote cyber-security validation solutions in Riga, Latvia, on October 29. Co-funded by the European Defence Fund, the system connects 19 test sites across the European Union and Norway to allow industry and commanders to verify system resilience before deployment.

stories.title: FCC to Vote on Rules for Drone Communications, Detection and Satellite Connectivity
stories.summary: FCC Chairman Brendon Carr announced that the Commission will vote on final rules to modernize drone and aviation connectivity. The October 29 vote would open the 800 MHz Cellular band for UAS, while the November 19 vote would address 450 MHz data links, 24 GHz drone detection, 800 MHz air-ground broadband, and 28.35 to 28.6 GHz satellite connectivity.

stories.title: Who Actually Hires Drone Operators? What the FAA's Survey Shows, and What It Doesn't
stories.summary: The FAA's 2025 Survey of UAS Operators found that 2,930 core Part 107 operators reported activity in construction and 2,773 in real estate, while 1,046 emergency response organizations reported an average of eight pilots per program. The agency noted that 2024 and 2025 flight estimates are not directly comparable due to a changed sample design.

stories.title: Leonardo selects Shield AI’s Hivemind software for Proteus autonomous helicopter
stories.summary: Leonardo selected Shield AI's Hivemind software to develop autonomous capabilities for its Proteus uncrewed helicopter, supporting future Royal Navy operations. The agreement allows Leonardo engineers to use the Hivemind Software Development Kit to build, test, and update mission-specific autonomy for anti-submarine warfare, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, and military logistics.

stories.title: Sentrycs offers portable counter-drone system for USD99,000
stories.summary: Sentrycs announced a USD99,000 fixed-price package for its portable Ranger counter-uncrewed aircraft system, including three years of maintenance, as US states prepare to access new federal counter-drone funding. The US Federal Emergency Management Agency announced an additional USD250 million in grants on 16 October, covering all 50 states, five territories and the District of Columbia.

stories.title: Intelic air defence part of Dutch government announcement of EUR500 million Ukraine support package
stories.summary: The Dutch Government announced a EUR500 million military support package for Ukraine on 28 October, focused on air defence and drones. The announcement followed a meeting between Prime Minister Rob Jetten and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky at the Catshuis in The Hague.

stories.title: FAA Official Says Commercial eVTOL Flights Before Type Certification Would Be 'Very Limited'
stories.summary: Caitlin Locke, the Federal Aviation Administration's Deputy Associate Administrator for Safety Oversight and Certification, said that even if the agency allows revenue-generating commercial operations by electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft that have not yet received type certification, such activity "will be very limited." She stated that any such request would face rigorous review and would have to be well justified by the lessons the FAA expects to draw from it, and that conditions and limitations would be placed on it.

stories.title: Aseon Labs Unveils World's First Portable, Fleet-Neutral Robotic Pit Stop for Autonomous Vehicles
stories.summary: Aseon Labs unveiled its first fully built robotic service pod in Redwood City, California, on October 29, 2026. The portable unit combines robotic arms, cameras, and charging equipment to provide charging, cleaning, and inspection directly in fleet operating zones. The completed unit is now undergoing testing for deployment by major autonomous vehicle operators.

stories.title: Aseon Labs Debuts Portable Robotic Pit Stop to Cut Robotaxi Downtime
stories.summary: Aseon Labs introduced its first fully built robotic service pod on Thursday, a portable unit designed to reduce robotaxi downtime by bringing routine service directly into operating zones. The Redwood City, California-based company said the unit is now undergoing testing for deployment by major autonomous vehicle operators, following a $10 million seed financing announced in June.

stories.title: Matternet Deal Opens 2,300 Hospitals to a Drone the FAA Hasn't Cleared
stories.summary: Matternet will sell its M3 drone delivery system through TransLogic, the Swisslog Healthcare unit whose pneumatic tube systems run inside more than 2,300 North American hospitals, under a partnership the two companies announced Thursday morning. TransLogic’s sales team becomes a distribution channel for the M3 across its customer base of more than 3,000 hospitals worldwide.

stories.title: Rick Scott doubles down on DJI and Autel drone restrictions as FCC reviews appeals
stories.summary: Senator Rick Scott urged FCC Chairman Brendan Carr to keep DJI and Autel Robotics on the Covered List, citing a classified Department of War report that deems both companies a national security risk. The FCC placed Scott's letter in the official records for the companies' pending challenges, which do not establish new flight restrictions for existing drone owners.

stories.title: Increased security spotted near Mar-a-Lago ahead of possible Trump visit
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration issued flight restrictions for the Palm Beach area from Friday, Oct. 30, through Sunday, Nov. 1. The Town of Palm Beach announced that South Ocean Boulevard will close between South County Road and Southern Boulevard beginning Friday at 5 a.m.

stories.title: Kodiak AI, DTL Transport Sign Deal for 75 Driverless Trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI and DTL Transport signed a binding agreement to deploy Kodiak’s autonomous-driving system on 75 driverless trucks owned by the California freight carrier. DTL will pay a per-mile fee to use the trucks on long-haul routes across the Sun Belt, initially along Interstate 10 between Dallas and El Paso, Texas, and Interstate 20 between Dallas and Atlanta.

stories.title: Ukraine Advances AI Drone Targeting Amid War With Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense manufacturers are expanding the use of artificial intelligence in combat drones to improve target recognition and maintain flight guidance when electronic warfare disrupts navigation or communications. The Fourth Law and Odd Systems produce AI-equipped drones used by Ukrainian military units, while TAF Industries has introduced an upgraded Kolibri 10-inch FPV drone featuring an AI targeting system developed by DOD Solution.

stories.title: Kodiak and DTL Transport partner to deploy 75 autonomous trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI and DTL Transport entered a binding agreement for DTL to deploy 75 Kodiak trucks within its fleet. DTL will pay a per-mile fee to haul produce along Interstate 10 between Dallas and El Paso, Texas, and Interstate 20 between Dallas and Atlanta.

stories.title: French startup Bleu Robotics secures €5 million to teach humanoid robots new tasks with fewer demonstrations
stories.summary: Bleu Robotics raised a €5 million pre-Seed round to reduce humanoid robot deployment to one hour or shorter. The Paris-based startup uses abductive learning to teach robots new tasks from as few as ten operator demonstrations, aiming for 99%+ accuracy in industrial settings.

stories.title: Tensrai Raises Rs 3.4 Cr To Make Existing Machines Autonomous
stories.summary: Hyderabad-based Tensrai raised Rs 3.4 crore in a pre-seed round from India Accelerator, Finvolve, and Hyderabad Angels to retrofit existing industrial machines with autonomous capabilities. The startup plans to use the capital to expand its technology and enter domestic and international markets.

stories.title: First Breach Advances Ammunition and Drone Manufacturing Expansion as U.S. Reshoring Accelerates
stories.summary: First Breach Inc. is advancing its Hagerstown manufacturing expansion, targeting scaled drone production by Q2 2027. The company currently has approximately 80,000 square feet dedicated to ammunition manufacturing, with more than 200,000 additional contiguous square feet under development.

stories.title: Sentrycs Offers Ranger a Portable C-UAS Solution with Mitigation Capabilities for less than $100,000 Helping States Maximize FEMA's Latest Round of Grant Funding
stories.summary: Sentrycs announced a $99,000 firm-fixed-price offering for its portable Ranger system, including three years of maintenance, to help state and local agencies expand counter-drone capabilities. The package supports FEMA's October 16 announcement of an additional $250 million in funding for 56 recipients to bolster nationwide counter-unmanned aircraft systems operations.

stories.title: China’s Rokae Robotics Announces Delivery of its 10,000th Humanoid Force-Controlled Arm
stories.summary: Rokae Robotics delivered its 10,000th humanoid force-controlled arm in September from its Shandong Province base, with more than 80 industrial partners integrating the hardware into production applications.

stories.title: Zimbabwe’s upcoming accession to rolling stock financing agreement opens ‘many doors’
stories.summary: The government has approved the country’s accession to an international treaty which aims to make it easier and cheaper for the private sector to finance rolling stock.

stories.title: A collision between two trains in central Spain has killed 68 people and injured dozens.
stories.summary: A RENFE high-speed train crashed into a stopped IRYO train in Toledo, Spain, on October 28, killing at least 68 people and injuring dozens. Transport Minister Oscar Puente attributed the collision to an "inexplicable" order from the central control center to resume service without speed restrictions after a computer failure.

stories.title: Aurora will miss 2026 goal but remains on track for 2027
stories.summary: Aurora Innovation expects to miss its 2026 target of 200 trucks, reaching that level in February after supplier constraints delayed production. The company remains on track to deploy 1,000 trucks by the end of 2027, supported by demand from nine customers.

stories.title: Head of California high-speed rail agency resigns amid travel expenses scandal
stories.summary: Ian Choudri resigned as CEO of California’s high-speed rail authority late Wednesday, citing personal priorities, after state investigators found consultants spent nearly $600,000 on questionable trips. Joe Stephenshaw, who has led the state Department of Finance since July 2022, will replace Choudri, according to a board announcement Thursday.

stories.title: Archer and ITA Airways Partner on the Development of Air Taxi Services in Italy – Company Announcement
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and ITA Airways signed an agreement to partner on an all-electric air taxi network in Italy using Archer's Midnight aircraft. The partnership aims to replace 60–90 minute drives with 10–20 minute flights, such as a trip from Fiumicino Airport to Rome’s city center. ITA Airways becomes the first European carrier to join Archer's global network of airline partners.

stories.title: Tesla CyberCab goes on display in Malaysia – driverless taxi with butterfly doors, no steering wheel or pedals
stories.summary: Tesla Malaysia began a four-mall preview tour for the CyberCab in Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, and Penang from October 29 to November 22. The two-seat robotaxi features butterfly doors and no steering wheel, but the country lacks autonomous driving regulations to allow it on public roads.

stories.title: Reach Power Achieves First-of-Its-Kind Persistent Autonomous Drone Flight Powered Wirelessly for 10 Hours
stories.summary: Reach Power completed a 10-hour autonomous drone flight powered by wireless beaming on September 22 at the Virginia Tech Institute for Advanced Computing. The demonstration, part of Operational Energy-Innovation’s 2026 Energy Sentry event, extended the drone’s 90-second battery life by approximately 400X without external tracking or manual controls.

stories.title: UgCS 6.3 adds terrain-following control for complex drone LiDAR surveys
stories.summary: SPH Engineering released UgCS 6.3, which extends the Large Projects workflow to LiDAR surveys and automatically includes IMU calibration maneuvers for supported DJI LiDAR sensors. The update allows operators to organize sites measuring 100 hectares or more as a single project and configure DJI LiDAR settings directly in the software.

stories.title: Spain’s deadly train crash adds new complication to Sanchez’s re-election campaign
stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez pledged to investigate the Oct 28 train crash in Toledo province that killed 68 people, stating he would address any failures that come to light. The accident occurred nine months after another deadly crash on the same line, complicating his re-election campaign ahead of the Nov 29 vote.

stories.title: Russian Military Intercepts Record 1.2K Ukrainian Drones Overnight
stories.summary: Russian air defense systems intercepted a record 1,214 Ukrainian drones across the country, the Defense Ministry said Thursday. Authorities in Ukraine reported that a Russian drone strike on a train platform in the Dnipro region killed at least 14 people and wounded five others.

stories.title: Alameda County supervisors approve 10-year Flock Safety drone contract
stories.summary: The Alameda County Board of Supervisors approved a 10-year contract for two drone docking stations for Flock Safety’s Drone as First Responder program. The Sheriff’s Office will install the stations at the Alameda County Fire Department’s Station 23 in Cherryland to house, launch and deploy drones for ongoing crimes and emergencies.

stories.title: Tesla expands its Robotaxi in Houston with a rocket-shaped geofence
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Robotaxi service area in Houston to cover about 254 square miles, a tenfold increase over the initial zone. The service operates with a fleet of 34 driverless Model Ys restricted to low-speed roads.

stories.title: Death Toll of High-Speed Train Crash in Spain Rises to 69
stories.summary: A massive recovery operation is underway in Spain after a violent high-speed train collision, with the death toll rising to 69. Crews are searching for additional victims as anger grows among the public.

stories.title: Big Sky rail plan moves closer to restoring passenger service through North Dakota
stories.summary: The Big Sky Passenger Rail Authority completed initial steps to restore Chicago-to-Seattle passenger service and is awaiting authorization to develop a core service plan. The authority is seeking a $320,000 nonfederal match for a $3.2 million phase, while North Dakota remains the only state to allocate funding for this effort.

stories.title: Tesla’s rocket-shaped Houston Robotaxi map has a hole where downtown should be
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Houston Robotaxi service area to roughly 254 square miles on October 26, but the app rejects downtown pickup requests despite the location being inside the published boundary. The service currently operates with 34 driverless Model Y cars, and Tesla has not provided an explanation for the routing gap.

stories.title: Lava Drone Regiment Completes Autonomous Ground Robot Mission Using 3D Route Mapping
stories.summary: The Lava Drone Regiment completed an autonomous ground robot mission using a 3D route map generated by laser sensor technology and Apex AI software. Military personnel maintained oversight to adjust the route and speed in real time. The regiment plans to use these ground robotic complexes for evacuation missions, having previously tested parachute drops from heavy Griffon bombers and strikes up to 15 kilometers behind front lines.

stories.title: The Spanish railway industry is shaken by the disaster.
stories.summary: Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente said a computer malfunction caused the safety system to stop working during the October 28th collision in Toledo, which killed at least 68 people. The Madrid railway control center instructed one train to resume its journey at normal speed, causing it to crash into the stopped Iryo train.

stories.title: Helsing Unveils AI-Controlled Air Defense System to Counter Mass Drone Attacks, 2 Missile Interceptors
stories.summary: Helsing unveiled Contra, an AI-controlled air defense system, and two interceptors, AD-1 Inferno and AD-2 Ambush, designed to counter mass drone attacks at lower costs than existing missile interceptors.

stories.title: Protests erupt in Spain after train crash kills dozens
stories.summary: Spain declared three days of mourning after at least 69 people died in a train crash in Toledo, the country's deadliest rail accident in decades. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez pledged safety improvements after a central command center ordered a train to resume operations without speed restrictions following a security system failure.

stories.title: What we know about Spain’s second high-speed rail tragedy this year
stories.summary: A high-speed train operated by Renfe crashed into a stationary Iryo train near Urda, Spain, killing at least 68 people and injuring about 80. Authorities blamed an “inexplicable” order from a rail control centre that allowed the moving train to resume normal speed after a signalling failure.

stories.title: From dancing robots and coffee makers on Nguyen Hue Walking Street to the challenge of mastering technology.
stories.summary: AICAP Group Joint Stock Company announced a strategic cooperation with the China Robot Industry Development Alliance, AIBRAIN Company, and Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology at the GRECO 2026 exhibition in Ho Chi Minh City. The collaboration aims to connect domestic market demand with international robot supply and develop technology deployment capabilities in Vietnam.

stories.title: Anti-drone tech dominates Pitch Day at the 2026 UAS Summit & Expo
stories.summary: Organizers selected six finalists for the pitch sessions at the 2026 UAS Summit & Expo in Grand Forks, ND, where five companies presented counter-UAS and defense-related drone technology. The event drew nearly 800 attendees and 67 exhibitors, making it the largest gathering in its 20-year history.

stories.title: A Ukrainian ground drone carried out its first combat mission under AI control
stories.summary: Soldiers from the “Lava” Unmanned Systems Regiment executed a combat logistics mission where an AI-controlled ground drone autonomously navigated 93% of a 20-kilometer route, with human intervention limited to a single 1.4-kilometer section. Military officials stated this marks the world’s first use of such technology in combat conditions, reducing operator workload and dependence on Starlink terminals.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics Raises $100M in Series A Funding to Expand Autonomous Assembly for Defense, Industry
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics raised $100 million in Series A funding led by Marlinspike Partners to expand its 130,000-square-foot Emeryville facility and deploy AI models for defense and industrial hardware assembly. The company stated the expansion provides 20 times the previous capacity and allows it to take customers from design to production in weeks without requiring them to build their own production lines.

stories.title: German unmanned ground vehicle gets Ukrainian SABER weapon station
stories.summary: German defense startup ARX Robotics and Ukrainian manufacturer Roboneers completed initial integration tests of Roboneers’ SABER remote weapon station on ARX’s GEREON unmanned ground vehicle, planning to start fitting armed versions by the end of 2026. The first SABER modules will be integrated in M2 and MK 19 (M) configurations, built around the .50-caliber M2 heavy machine gun and the 40 mm MK 19 automatic grenade launcher.

stories.title: Former Tesla Autopilot Chief Slams Elon Musk's Vision-Only Strategy as a 'Weird Religious Stance That Ignores Physics'
stories.summary: Sterling Anderson, General Motors Co.’s GM Chief Product Officer and former Tesla Inc. TSLA Director of the Autopilot system, dismissed a vision-only approach to self-driving, citing limitations of the technology when compared with radar- and LiDAR-based systems.

stories.title: FCC proposes spectrum changes for drone communications and counter-UAS detection
stories.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) will consider proposed rules at its 19 November meeting to expand spectrum access for uncrewed aircraft communications, counter-drone detection, and in-flight connectivity. The proposals include opening the 450 MHz band to safety-related data links and allowing ground-based radar systems to use the 24.45–24.65 GHz band to detect and track unauthorised or dangerous drones near airports, borders, prisons, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Spain train crash puts its high-speed rail safety record under scrutiny
stories.summary: Two high-speed trains crashed between Mora and Orgaz, near Toledo, Spain, on October 28, 2026, killing 68 people and injuring many others. Spain declared a three-day mourning period following the collision, which marked the second major train accident in the country this year.

stories.title: Iran claims capture of US spy drone west of the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say they captured a US “spy and deception” drone west of the Strait of Hormuz, the IRNA news agency reported. The IRGC Navy stated that fighters from its Electronic Warfare Unit “succeeded in safely landing an American terrorist army spy and deception drone (MQM-170) west of the Strait of Hormuz.”

stories.title: AGIBOT Unveils Worken Framework to Quantify Robots’ Useful Output
stories.summary: AGIBOT introduced Worken, a framework for measuring robots' productive output, at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai on October 29, 2026. The company also unveiled its AHA3 hardware platform, GO-3 Preview model, WITA-Omni interaction model, G2 Max industrial robot, and Link-U OS 1.0.

stories.title: VIDEO | Rownd opens Richfield drone center as company expands AI and defense technology jobs
stories.summary: Rownd Inc. opened a research and development center in the Village of Richfield, Wisconsin, and announced a $10 million contract with the Department of War. The company expects its expansion in Wisconsin and North Carolina to create 22 careers, including next-generation manufacturing positions and jobs developing autonomous systems.

stories.title: High Eye Integrates Intelic NEXUS into Airboxer, Expanding Software IntegrationCapabilities and Mission Modularity
stories.summary: High Eye integrated Intelic’s NEXUS command-and-control software into its Airboxer unmanned helicopter, validating the system during a flight lasting more than four hours. The integration standardizes how mission equipment connects to the aircraft, supports interoperability with wider unmanned systems, and reduces configuration-specific development effort by allowing components to be adapted or replaced with less impact on the rest of the system.

stories.title: Iran Claims 14th US MQ-1 Drone Shot Down Near Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on October 29 that its aerospace force destroyed a 14th US MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, east of Sirik in Hormozgan Province. The United States Central Command had not confirmed or denied the loss as of publication.

stories.title: inDrive, Pony.ai and NVIDIA explore robotaxi launch in Kazakhstan’s Astana
stories.summary: inDrive, Pony.ai, and NVIDIA signed a memorandum of understanding to explore robotaxi deployment in Kazakhstan, selecting Astana as the potential first location. The partnership will assess technical and regulatory feasibility using Pony.ai Gen-7 vehicles and NVIDIA Hyperion infrastructure, with a launch subject to government agreement.

stories.title: BMW factories have moved one million cars without drivers
stories.summary: BMW reported that more than one million cars have travelled through its production plants without drivers, with four factories now using Automated Driving In-Plant technology. Mini Plant Oxford recorded 53,000 automated journeys in the past year, contributing to the milestone, while BMW plans to deploy the system at Plant Spartanburg in the United States in 2027.

stories.title: Sentosa to pilot on-demand autonomous vehicle service in 2027
stories.summary: Sentosa Development Corporation and TADA Mobility will launch a pilot on-demand shared autonomous vehicle service on Sentosa in early 2027. The initial phase will use two WeRide vehicles to connect 27 pick-up and drop-off points across the island's western side, operating from 1pm to 7pm at no cost to visitors.

stories.title: Spanish rescuers search trains in hope of finding survivors of deadly crash that killed 68
stories.summary: Rescuers searched wrecked carriages in Toledo on Thursday for survivors of Spain's second deadly high-speed train crash this year, which has claimed 68 lives. Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente said the crash happened after a signal failure caused trains to stop automatically, while a state-run Renfe train was authorized to proceed at normal speed past a stationary Iryo-operated train.

stories.title: SkyDrive Signs MOU with Six Singapore Companies for eVTOL Component R&D and Technical Validation
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with six Singapore-based companies to jointly research, develop, and validate eVTOL component technologies. The agreement, signed at the Singapore Week of Innovation & Technology, covers advanced manufacturing, batteries, and flight operations management.

stories.title: Air Force tests XQ-67A drone to scout enemy air defenses before crewed fighters do
stories.summary: The U.S. Air Force flew its experimental XQ-67A drone over the Nevada Test and Training Range to test autonomous scouting and beyond-line-of-sight communications. The Oct. 27 test, led by the Air Force Research Laboratory, evaluated onboard mission equipment and software to provide aircrews with a fuller tactical picture.

stories.title: FAA Restricts Airspace Over Chillicothe and Columbus Area for Trump's Wednesday Visit to Shoemaker Center
stories.summary: The FAA imposed temporary flight restrictions over Chillicothe and the Columbus area for Wednesday, October 28, while President Donald J. Trump visits the Shoemaker Center. The restrictions, set out in NOTAM FDC 6/2268, create six areas with airspace closed from the surface up to 17,999 feet.

stories.title: White County’s new drone expands reach of emergency responders
stories.summary: White County Public Safety purchased a new drone with Special Purpose Local Option Sales Tax funds to assist emergency responders in search and rescue, fire tracking, and storm damage assessment. The aircraft features upgraded thermal imaging, a live loudspeaker, and the ability to fly in rain, capabilities that allow missions to continue when wet weather would have grounded the county’s earlier drones.

stories.title: Turkey’s 60,000-ton Largest Warship Might Also Be The First Carrier To Combine Unmanned Systems
stories.summary: Turkiye is building the MUGEM aircraft carrier at the Istanbul Naval Shipyard, with commissioning expected by 2032. The 60,000-tonne vessel will be the first carrier to combine unmanned systems, launching drone aircraft, unmanned ships, and underwater vehicles.

stories.title: SkyDrive Signs MOU with Six Singapore Tech Companies to Collaborate on Advanced Air Mobility R&D
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with six Singapore-based technology companies to collaborate on joint research, development, and technical validation for electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft. The agreement, signed at the Singapore Week of Innovation & Technology, focuses on key component technologies including advanced manufacturing, batteries, rapid prototyping, and flight operations management.

stories.title: Spain faces pressure after high-speed rail tragedy.
stories.summary: A collision between two high-speed trains in Toledo province on October 28 killed at least 68 people, becoming Europe's most serious railway disaster since 2013. Spanish Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that a computer communication malfunction caused the LZB safety control system to stop working on a stretch of approximately 63 km, forcing many trains to halt.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi users are reporting strange routing choices as the service expands
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Houston robotaxi service area by 229 square miles on Monday, but riders reported routing issues including a 40-minute ride for two blocks and unavailable locations within the new geofence.

stories.title: Connecting Appalachia: Laurie McKnight of Ohio University on How Electric Aviation Could Unlock Rural Opportunity
VESSEL REVIEW | 3D-printed prototype for Dutch Ministry of Defence USV programme
stories.summary: The Maritime Research Institute Netherlands (MARIN) completed initial trials of the first working prototype under SeaRush, a Dutch Ministry of Defence project to develop cost-effective unmanned surface vehicles using 3D printing. MARIN conducted the first on-water tests of the eight-metre prototype in the Rijnhaven in Wageningen in December 2025, with the design progressing from concept to floating test platform in five months.

stories.title: Spain built a high-speed rail giant. Has maintenance lagged behind?
stories.summary: Spain's infrastructure manager, Adif, announced a €78.1 million contract in November 2025 for specialised maintenance of signalling and traffic-management equipment across the railway network. The work includes preventive maintenance, continuous monitoring, periodic servicing and urgent repairs.

stories.title: Autonomous Bus Market to Reach USD 16.00 Billion by 2033 | Level 4 Driverless Buses, Electric Shuttles & Key M
stories.summary: Coherent Market Insights projects the global autonomous bus market will grow from USD 2.80 billion in 2026 to USD 16.00 billion by 2033, with a compound annual growth rate of 11.0%. The report identifies Level 2 automation as the dominant segment, holding a 41.0% market share in 2026, while hardware accounts for 53.0% of the market.

stories.title: Zero Trust Framework Proposed to Secure Autonomous Police and Rescue Drones
stories.summary: Swarnamouli Majumdar and Anjali Awasthi proposed the Zero Trust Agentic Drone Public-Safety framework, or ZTADP, in a systematic review published in Discover Robotics. The six-layer model extends continuous verification to include an Agentic Reasoning layer that validates AI tool calls against a least-privilege allow-list and routes consequential actions through human confirmation.

stories.title: Iran says it destroyed 14th US-made MQ-1 drone over Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps intercepted and destroyed an MQ-1 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz, marking the 14th such drone it says its air defence system has brought down, the semi-official ISNA news agency reported on Thursday.

stories.title: Europe Today: Second high-speed rail disaster in nine months leaves Spain in grief
stories.summary: A train crash in Spain killed at least 68 people, marking the second high-speed rail disaster in nine months. The tragedy is putting pressure on Pedro Sánchez ahead of Spain's general election.

stories.title: Video. Second high-speed rail disaster in nine months leaves Spain in grief
stories.summary: At least 68 people died and over 100 were injured when two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid, marking Spain's second deadly rail crash this year. Sánchez pledged a tough line on possible safety failures following the Toledo train crash.

stories.title: Your industrial drones collect data. Percepto wants AI to make it count
Drone delivery noise is becoming a problem. Zipline has a new answer
stories.summary: Zipline announced that its sound-optimized dynamic flying technology is now running across its entire fleet, reducing overall sound exposure per flight by 68% and peak-volume noise by 24% compared with its 2025 fleet. The company states the upgrade also shortened average flight time by 53 seconds and reduced energy consumption per flight by 21%.

stories.title: Audi plans humanoid robot trial to sort factory parts
stories.summary: Audi announced a proof of concept with Agile Robots, Dassault Systèmes and Nvidia to automate parts sequencing at its Ingolstadt Production Lab. The partners are using virtual twins to test mobile humanoid robots that retrieve components from mixed containers, aiming to reduce repetitive manual workload in material supply.

stories.title: Indian Railways: Passenger Trains To Run Beneath Bullet Train Station For The First Time
stories.summary: Indian Railways completed statutory safety inspections for three new broad-gauge tracks at Ahmedabad station, enabling passenger trains to run beneath the elevated high-speed terminal for the first time in India. Commercial operations on these platforms are expected to commence before Diwali, pending final administrative clearances.

stories.title: Aurora to fit 20 driverless trucks a week from December
stories.summary: Aurora Innovation expects to fit its driverless system to 20 trucks a week with upfitting partner Roush from early December, building annual capacity beyond 1,000 vehicles. Federal regulators granted a five-year exemption allowing stopped driverless trucks to use cab-mounted beacons in place of hand-placed roadside warnings.

stories.title: China’s Embodied AI Industry Opens New Career Paths As Robot Sector Expands
stories.summary: China's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced 11 new professions in September, including embodied AI robot application technicians and digital twin engineers. The country produced more than 40,000 humanoid robot units in the first half of 2026.

stories.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense firms The Fourth Law and Odd Systems produce the Lupynis-10-TFL-1, an autonomous drone that uses artificial intelligence to navigate the final 500 meters of a flight and select targets. Dozens of Ukrainian military units already use the system, which relies on a deep-learning neural network to recognize vehicles and flying objects. The company states that humans select the target, while the drone handles the final approach and strike.

stories.title: Sentosa and Tada to kick off autonomous vehicle rides in early 2027
stories.summary: Statutory board Sentosa Development Corp and ride-hailing company Tada Mobility launched an autonomous vehicle service on Thursday (Oct 29), with public rides planned for early 2027. The pilot uses two self-driving shuttles from WeRide, each with a capacity of eight passengers, operating from 1 pm to 7 pm daily across the west of Sentosa.

stories.title: FAA Proposes New Class D Airspace Around Winter Haven, Florida, Ahead of Control Tower Opening
stories.summary: The FAA proposed Class D airspace at Winter Haven, Florida, extending from the surface to 2,500 feet MSL, to manage instrument flight rules operations ahead of a new control tower opening. The rule is scheduled for publication in the Federal Register on 2026-10-29 under docket number 26-ASO-18, with the FAA inviting written comments on its regulatory and economic aspects.

stories.title: AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
stories.summary: AGIBOT introduced Worken, a proposed framework for measuring robot productivity in real-world environments, at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai. The company also unveiled AHA3, its integrated hardware platform, and debuted GO-3 Preview, its next-generation embodied AI foundation model.

stories.title: Spain tops world toll for high-speed rail deaths after Urda crash
stories.summary: Spain recorded 114 high-speed rail deaths in 2026, surpassing Germany's 1998 Eschede disaster, after a Renfe AVE train struck a stationary Iryo service near Urda on October 28, killing at least 68 people. Transport minister Óscar Puente attributed the crash to a computer failure and manual command errors, while hundreds protested outside the ministry demanding his resignation.

stories.title: Is high-speed rail generally safe? What can Australia learn from Spain’s accident?
stories.summary: A high-speed train carrying 397 passengers collided with a stationary train holding 147 people on the Madrid–Seville line, killing at least 68 and injuring dozens. Spain’s transport minister described a signalling disruption as the cause, marking the second fatal accident on this route this year.
